models.method: Justin independent assumptions, not consensus or management guidance. Revenue=average revenue-earning MW×realized annual $M/MW+other. D&A=average in-service GPU cost/5+infrastructure D&A. Gross profit=revenue×(1−cash cost ratio)−all D&A (analytical fully burdened definition). EBITDA=revenue×(1−cash cost ratio)−cash opex−SBC; includes SBC, unlike issuer adjusted EBITDA shown in inputs. Pretax=EBITDA−D&A−average debt×cash interest rate−noncash customer-financing interest+average cash×cash yield. Net income=pretax−max(pretax,0)×20%; no tax benefit on losses or investment marks. FCF=net income+D&A+SBC+noncash customer-financing interest+new prepayments−recognition of prepaid revenue−other WC−capex. No debt proceeds in FCF. All debt interest expensed for conservative comparability; no capitalized-interest benefit.
gaps: Average earning MW is a scenario driver, not disclosed live installed MW; utilization and commissioning embedded once.
New-contract >$25M ACV/MW is not fleet realized yield; selected lower/higher yields model mix and repricing.
Cohort commissioning, useful-life mix and cash prepayment recognition schedule are not disclosed in enough detail for precise GAAP forecasts.
No proceeds from strategic investment disposals; no speculative gains. All D&A assigned to gross profit analytically, unlike issuer presentation.

september_customer_funding.reason: Note 4 reports a net liability movement and recognition from the opening balance only. Gross collections require the full roll-forward, including recognition of current-period deposits and noncash movements.
september_customer_funding.basis: 40% of September RPO over the next 24 months. This includes qualifying deferred revenue and unbilled commitments and excludes contracts originally one year or shorter. It does not specify quarterly deliveries or collections.

post_period_construction_advance.basis: Note 4 describes an additional advance by Nebius to construction VIEs. It is a use of funds after September 30. Subsequent discretionary lending is excluded. Other intervening movements prevent a current cash estimate.

report.thesis: Long-term business opportunity is credible; funding and delivery determine whether it becomes attractive per-share value. Prefer conditional ownership over chasing the reported contract total. The base model grows strongly but remains materially cash-consuming through2028; require cash-funded construction and per-share economics before upgrading to Buy.
report.conviction: Moderate on demand; low-to-moderate on cash-flow and valuation precision.

catalysts.event: Previously December ARR milestone now expected February; verify delivery, not only run-rate optics.
Remaining New Jersey Microsoft capacity scheduled for delivery.
Management pre-tax breakeven objective is an exit milestone, not full-year net-profit guidance.

risks: Repeated external-site delays; contract termination/service credits.
GPU replacement and useful-life extension can flatter accounting earnings versus cash economics.
Capital raises and customer/preferred financing claims can absorb growth.
Short-term new-deal premium pricing may normalize as capacity expands.
Three unnamed customers generated70% of Q3 revenue; one represented75% of receivables, so collection timing matters despite broader customer additions.
invalidation: Further material delivery slippage without protected customer economics.
2027 funding coverage falls below management75% lower bound without a credible funded alternative.
Prepayments or receivable collections fail to match the construction schedule.
missing: Current instrument-level fully diluted shares and actual Citi draws.
Site/cohort commissioning schedule and prepaid-revenue amortization by customer.
2028 capex, funding mix, GPU residual values and sustainable renewal pricing.
The New Jersey tranche MW, refund rights and timing of new customer deposits determine whether an acceptance delay primarily affects earnings or also consumes cash.

model_definitions.gross_profit: Analytical revenue minus cash service costs and ALL modeled D&A; conservative full D&A assignment, not issuer GAAP gross-profit subtotal.
model_definitions.ebitda: Unadjusted analytical EBITDA includes SBC. Issuer-style adjusted EBITDA stored separately in inputs.
model_definitions.net_income: Normalized consolidated scenario excludes unpredictable investment marks/acquisition gains and assumes no tax-loss benefit; not a promised GAAP result.
model_definitions.fcf: Levered operating cash approximation less cash capex, with customer advances explicitly rolled through; excludes financing proceeds. Cannot infer distributable cash from EBITDA.
model_definitions.calibration: Q3 issuer adjusted EBITDA47.49% and cloud segment53% do not set forecast margins mechanically. Modeled EBITDA margins rise with selected cash overhead operating leverage; this is an explicit optimistic scale assumption in base/bull, stressable through costs/opex.

delivery_stress.anchor: On November 12 Nebius scheduled the remaining New Jersey Microsoft tranches for Q2 2027. Actual tranche size and customer cash timing remain unresolved.
delivery_stress.assumption: Justin sensitivity in USD millions. Shift 100 illustrative revenue-earning MW from April 1 to July 1. Q2 loses one full service quarter. Q3 and Q4 resume the original run rate with no catch-up billing. The 100 MW is a unit sensitivity, not an issuer estimate.
delivery_stress.cash_basis: Variable service costs flex. D&A, capex, fixed costs, financing and new deposits stay at scenario levels. At one cash endpoint the missed service would have been collected during 2027. At the other the cash was already received, so deferred revenue recognition falls by the missed revenue. Refunds, credits and revised deposit dates require contract evidence.
